reason: Conversation 2 immediately identified the boil-over moisture on the touch controls as the likely cause of Er03, gave a safe isolate-dry-retest procedure with no internal access, correctly declared the hob fine to use once it worked with controls dry and clear, and set a sensible threshold for engineer service while recommending no part. Conversation 1 misdiagnosed Er03 as overheat protection despite the boil-over being stated in the opener, then escalated to a 'stop using this appliance' and electrician warning that is disproportionate for a built-in hob with liquid on the glass control strip, never addressing the actual fix of drying the controls.
